admission_rule: This queue may contain only actions that are genuinely non-delegable because they require owner identity, an owner-held credential, an owner-authenticated client or a provider UI act. Retrieval, comparison, monitoring and merging are orchestrator work and must never appear here.
blocking_scope_rule: No action in this queue blocks the programme. Each names only the single route it unblocks.
